case.specification: Write a two-part integration guide for the Acme Widget service. Part 1: a complete local setup guide — prerequisites (Node.js 20 and Git), install commands, a config file example, and how to verify the server starts. Part 2: a complete migration guide for moving existing data from version 1 to version 2 — backup step, migration command, rollback step, and how to verify the migration. Both parts must be present and complete; each part is equally important.
case.summary: Part 1 only: complete local setup guide with prerequisites, install commands, config example and verification step. Part 2 (version 1 to version 2 migration guide) is not included.
case.design: Two equally important sections; Part 1 delivered complete, Part 2 entirely absent. This is the exact shape that split validators twice under the strict same-band rule (same verdict required, scores in the same band). The relaxed rule requires the same verdict with at most 10 points per dimension.
